replied.reply_text: That is a tricky one! Since Stripchat support has already checked your settings and is pointing to the Elgato Wave 3, it might be worth testing with a different audio input temporarily to rule that out — even a basic USB mic or your built-in mic. Sometimes Stripchat's audio engine handles certain USB audio interfaces differently than other platforms. If the issue only shows on Stripchat, it could also be worth reaching out to Elgato support to see if there are known compatibility notes. Hope you get it sorted soon! 💜
